listing.name: Doom / Doom II — UZDoom (andreyvelsk)
listing.summary: Follow the AYN Thor UZDoom setup for your own Doom or Doom II game data.

steps.title: Finish setup in the upstream Android app
steps.instruction: This fork’s published APK is for Android, specifically the AYN Thor dual-screen UZDoom route. Install this fork’s APK on the Android device, open its launcher deliberately, and select your own Doom or Doom II IWAD through the UZDoom setup. Other engines named in the inherited parent README have been excluded from this fork; do not prepare Doom RPG, Wolfenstein RPG or another parent engine for this APK.

steps.title: Keep your data when changing versions
steps.instruction: Keep your selected IWADs, mods and actual Android app data backed up before changing versions. This fork’s reviewed guide does not establish an exact save/export location. Its UZDoom renderer notes distinguish Adreno from Mali/PowerVR; follow the fork’s device guidance. Updates and device setup belong to the upstream Android app, outside Portcove runtime backup and rollback.

original_game_review.reason: The authored runtime/launcher accepts multiple Doom-family games and their distinct game data/mod choices. Preserve the broad engine scope rather than labeling it as one original.
